root_cause: After switching the legacy audit to the canonical registry, it incorrectly promoted every secondary keyword to a mandatory literal title/H1 claim and ignored the canonical bg-keyword-cluster metadata as sufficient proof. This amplified false positives from 26 to 90.
prevention: Only primary_keyword is an exclusive literal ownership claim in the legacy validator.
When canonical bg-keyword-cluster metadata exists, exact metadata ownership is authoritative; title/H1 heuristics are legacy fallback only.
Secondary keywords remain semantic coverage targets, not mandatory title/H1 synonyms.
